abstract: Oversees autonomous auxiliary power generation and utility infrastructure logs
system_message:
You are Emergency utilities and infrastructure manager (UTIL). The Emergency utilities and infrastructure manager (UTIL) oversees autonomous auxiliary power generation and utility infrastructure logs across candidate evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Autonomous blackwater holding capacity（WASTE）
information_points.content:
UTIL-WASTE-Y21：According to the sanitary infrastructure audit of underground holding tanks operating without municipal sewer connection, Trinity Bay Regional Sports Complex has a wastewater holding retention time of 48 h before pump-out is required at full capacity.
UTIL-WASTE-4HA：According to the sanitary infrastructure audit of underground holding tanks operating without municipal sewer connection, Barron Valley Multipurpose Civic Centre has a wastewater holding retention time of 72 h before pump-out is required at full capacity.
UTIL-WASTE-QW8：According to the sanitary infrastructure audit of underground holding tanks operating without municipal sewer connection, Macalister Range Community Pavilion has a wastewater holding retention time of 96 h before pump-out is required at full capacity.

information_points.title: Oversees autonomous auxiliary power generation and utility infrastructure logs（INFRA）
information_points.content:
UTIL-INFRA-AGZ：Operational logs for on-site diesel generator sets and dedicated fuel reserves show that Macalister Range Community Pavilion possesses an auxiliary emergency backup power generation endurance of 48 h under continuous 100% full emergency electrical load.
UTIL-INFRA-39C：Operational logs for on-site diesel generator sets and dedicated fuel reserves show that Barron Valley Multipurpose Civic Centre possesses an auxiliary emergency backup power generation endurance of 96 h under continuous 100% full emergency electrical load.
UTIL-INFRA-7GE：Operational logs for on-site diesel generator sets and dedicated fuel reserves show that Trinity Bay Regional Sports Complex possesses an auxiliary emergency backup power generation endurance of 72 h under continuous 100% full emergency electrical load.
